entities.summary: The Armenian Cathedral of the Assumption of Mary in Lviv, Ukraine is located in the city's Old Town, north of the market square. Until 1945 it was the cathedral of the Armenian Catholic Archeparchy of Lviv. Since 2000 it has served as the cathedral of the Armenian Diocese of Ukraine.
